description: The entity does not internally communicate information, including objectives and responsibilities for internal control, necessary to support the functioning of internal control.
applicability: Applies to all entities when control objectives are not communicated to personnel, control responsibilities are not clearly articulated, communication channels are inadequate, or employees are unaware of their control duties.

metadata.detection_notes: Review internal communication policies, evidence of control objective communications, employee awareness surveys, training materials, and documentation of control responsibilities. Look for absence of internal communications about controls, low employee awareness, or lack of communication channels.
